source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    a = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(a), len(a[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            if a[r][c] == 8 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            component = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                component.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y - 1, x), (y + 1, x), (y, x - 1), (y, x + 1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < height and 0 <= xx < width and a[yy][xx] != 8 and (yy, xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in component)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in component)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in component)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in component)
            colors = {a[y][x] for y, x in component if a[y][x] not in (0, 8)}
            if not colors:
                continue
            color = next(iter(colors))
            colored = [(y, x) for y, x in component if a[y][x] == color]
            tr0 = min(y for y, x in colored)
            tr1 = max(y for y, x in colored)
            tc0 = min(x for y, x in colored)
            tc1 = max(x for y, x in colored)
            tile_h, tile_w = tr1 - tr0 + 1, tc1 - tc0 + 1
            pattern = [[a[tr0 + i][tc0 + j] for j in range(tile_w)] for i in range(tile_h)]
            top, left = tr0 == r0, tc0 == c0
            for y in range(r0, r1 + 1):
                for x in range(c0, c1 + 1):
                    iy = (y - r0) % tile_h if top else tile_h - 1 - ((r1 - y) % tile_h)
                    ix = (x - c0) % tile_w if left else tile_w - 1 - ((c1 - x) % tile_w)
                    a[y][x] = pattern[iy][ix]
    return a
'''
